data_sent.title: Data Sent
data_sent.default: Only when an audit is started with use_llm=true and llm_consent=true: source snippets of the functions around static findings (and on their execution paths), finding descriptions, and module import summaries — redacted for secrets before sending. Content of sensitive files (.env, keys, credentials) is never sent, and the repository is never sent wholesale.

profile_id.title: Profile Id
profile_id.description: A SUCCEEDED profile of this workload; omitted = profile as part of the job

size.title: Size
size.description: Profile size when profile_id is omitted

CandidateRef.title: CandidateRef
CandidateRef.description: Reference to a validated patch candidate (resolved by a registered resolver).

CodeRole.title: CodeRole
CodeRole.description: Execution role of the code a finding sits in (see ``backend.audit.path_ranking``).

code_role.description: Execution role of the enclosing code (path ranking)

execution_path.title: Execution Path
execution_path.description: Best-effort path from the most critical entry point: 'module:qualname' items

local_directory_enabled.title: Local Directory Enabled
local_directory_enabled.description: True when PERFPILOT_LOCAL_ALLOWLIST lists at least one directory

JobAccepted.title: JobAccepted
JobAccepted.description: Returned (HTTP 202) by endpoints that start long-running work.

rejected_claims.title: Rejected Claims
rejected_claims.description: Statements dropped for claiming unmeasured runtime numbers

rejected_items.title: Rejected Items
rejected_items.description: Model recommendations/insights dropped by validation or guards

LimitsOverride.title: LimitsOverride
LimitsOverride.description: Optional per-run limits. Each value may only be tighter than the configured default.

attributed_time_ms.title: Attributed Time Ms
attributed_time_ms.description: Self time plus time in directly called non-repository code

measured_factor.title: Measured Factor
measured_factor.description: Multiplier applied to the static priority score

MeasuredEvidence.title: MeasuredEvidence
MeasuredEvidence.description:
Runtime evidence attached to a finding when a profiler confirms it.

The finding itself keeps its own provenance (e.g. ``STATIC`` for the static claim); this block
is always ``MEASURED`` because its numbers come from a real profiled run.

peak_rss_bytes.title: Peak Rss Bytes
peak_rss_bytes.description: getrusage ru_maxrss of the profiled process inside the sandbox

tracemalloc_peak_bytes.title: Tracemalloc Peak Bytes
tracemalloc_peak_bytes.description: Peak of Python-allocator allocations (tracemalloc) during the command

use_llm.title: Use Llm
use_llm.description: Consent to send the target function and its evidence to the configured LLM when no safe deterministic patch exists (requires a configured model)

size.title: Size
size.description: Defaults to the workload's default size

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: Where a result came from. Rendered on every finding, recommendation and metric.

expected_effect.title: Expected Effect
expected_effect.description: Qualitative hypothesis, never a measured number

approval_id.title: Approval Id
approval_id.description: A specific approved workload command of this audit (default: the latest)

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Whether the finding carried profiler evidence when the candidate was made

finding_id.title: Finding Id
finding_id.description: A finding of this audit (stable finding id)

approval_id.title: Approval Id
approval_id.description: A specific approved pytest command of this audit (default: the latest)

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: Branch, tag or commit for git sources

RepositoryRef.title: RepositoryRef
RepositoryRef.description: User-supplied pointer to a repository. Exactly one locator must be set per type.

measured_run_id.title: Measured Run Id
measured_run_id.description: Run whose evidence is on the findings

symbol.title: Symbol
symbol.description: Qualified name; None for module-level code

argv.title: Argv
argv.description: Must equal the discovered argv exactly; the approval pins it

trace_memory.title: Trace Memory
trace_memory.description: Run tracemalloc concurrently with cProfile (adds overhead to timings)
